#! python3
# DG VALIDATION HIGHLIGHTER: generated by Design Grammars. Do not edit by hand.
#   project: str-openings-01
#   rules:   R_STR_OPENING_ABOVE_V, R_STR_OPENING_BEAM_V, R_STR_OPENING_CLEARANCE_300_V, R_STR_OPENING_COLUMN_V
#
# Inputs:  Run (bool), Clear (bool), UniqueIds (list, from the calculator), RuleIds (list, from the calculator),
#          ValidStatus (tree, from VALIDATOR: one branch per rule in RuleIds order, one item per box)
# Outputs: Report, Violations (one line per violating box)
# Writes, in one undoable transaction in the active view: red = at least one rule violated, green = all rules pass,
# and the instance parameter DG_Violation (violated rule ids, ';'-joined; empty when the box passes).
import os
import tempfile

import clr
clr.AddReference("RevitAPI")
clr.AddReference("RhinoInside.Revit")
from Autodesk.Revit import DB
from RhinoInside.Revit import Revit

PARAM_NAME = "DG_Violation"
PARAM_GUID = "5f0c9b1e-3d2a-4c7e-9a61-1d2b3c4d5e03"
RED = DB.Color(220, 38, 38)
GREEN = DB.Color(22, 163, 74)
SHARED_FILE = (
    "# This is a Revit shared parameter file.\n# Do not edit manually.\n"
    "*META\tVERSION\tMINVERSION\nMETA\t2\t1\n*GROUP\tID\tNAME\nGROUP\t1\tDG\n"
    "*PARAM\tGUID\tNAME\tDATATYPE\tDATACATEGORY\tGROUP\tVISIBLE\tDESCRIPTION\tUSERMODIFIABLE\tHIDEWHENNOVALUE\n"
    "PARAM\t" + PARAM_GUID + "\t" + PARAM_NAME + "\tTEXT\t\t1\t1\tDesign Grammars rules violated by the element\t1\t0\n"
)


def branches_in_rule_order(tree):
    paths = sorted(list(tree.Paths), key=lambda p: tuple(p.Indices))
    return [list(tree.Branch(p)) for p in paths]


def solid_fill_id(doc):
    for fp in DB.FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(DB.FillPatternElement):
        if fp.GetFillPattern().IsSolidFill:
            return fp.Id
    return DB.ElementId.InvalidElementId


def ensure_parameter(doc, category):
    app = doc.Application
    previous = app.SharedParametersFilename
    path = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "dg_violation_shared_parameters.txt")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(SHARED_FILE)
    try:
        app.SharedParametersFilename = path
        definition = app.OpenSharedParameterFile().Groups.get_Item("DG").Definitions.get_Item(PARAM_NAME)
        cats = app.Create.NewCategorySet()
        cats.Insert(category)
        binding = app.Create.NewInstanceBinding(cats)
        if not doc.ParameterBindings.Insert(definition, binding, DB.GroupTypeId.Data):
            doc.ParameterBindings.ReInsert(definition, binding, DB.GroupTypeId.Data)
    finally:
        app.SharedParametersFilename = previous or ""


def override(color, fill_id):
    ogs = DB.OverrideGraphicSettings()
    ogs.SetSurfaceForegroundPatternId(fill_id)
    ogs.SetSurfaceForegroundPatternColor(color)
    ogs.SetCutForegroundPatternId(fill_id)
    ogs.SetCutForegroundPatternColor(color)
    ogs.SetProjectionLineColor(color)
    return ogs


Report = []
Violations = []

if not (Run or Clear):
    Report = ["Run = False: nothing written"]
else:
    doc = Revit.ActiveDBDocument
    view = doc.ActiveView if doc is not None else None
    uids = list(UniqueIds or [])
    rule_ids = list(RuleIds or [])
    elements = [doc.GetElement(u) for u in uids] if doc is not None else []
    with DB.Transaction(doc, "DG: check openings" if Run else "DG: clear opening colours") as t:
        t.Start()
        if Clear:
            for e in elements:
                if e is not None:
                    view.SetElementOverrides(e.Id, DB.OverrideGraphicSettings())
                    p = e.LookupParameter(PARAM_NAME)
                    if p is not None and not p.IsReadOnly:
                        p.Set("")
            Report = ["cleared %d boxes in view %s" % (len(elements), view.Name)]
        else:
            branches = branches_in_rule_order(ValidStatus)
            if len(branches) != len(rule_ids):
                raise ValueError("ValidStatus has %d branches but %d rules" % (len(branches), len(rule_ids)))
            first = next((e for e in elements if e is not None), None)
            if first is not None and first.LookupParameter(PARAM_NAME) is None:
                ensure_parameter(doc, first.Category)
            fill_id = solid_fill_id(doc)
            red = override(RED, fill_id)
            green = override(GREEN, fill_id)
            failed = 0
            for i, e in enumerate(elements):
                if e is None:
                    Report.append("missing element %s" % uids[i])
                    continue
                broken = [rule_ids[k] for k, branch in enumerate(branches) if i < len(branch) and not branch[i]]
                view.SetElementOverrides(e.Id, red if broken else green)
                p = e.LookupParameter(PARAM_NAME)
                if p is not None and not p.IsReadOnly:
                    p.Set(";".join(broken))
                if broken:
                    failed += 1
                    Violations.append("%s [%d]: %s" % (e.Name, e.Id.IntegerValue, ", ".join(broken)))
            Report.insert(0, "view %s: %d boxes, %d with violations, %d pass" % (view.Name, len(elements), failed, len(elements) - failed))
        t.Commit()
